## Preparation and aftercare

### 48 hours before
Complete any waxing or shaving now, so pores can settle. If you can, exfoliate gently the day before — polished skin takes retains color better. Then leave your skin alone: no oils, no self-tanner remnants, nothing on your skin.

### The day of
Arrive with bare skin — no moisturizer, deodorant, perfume, or makeup. Bring loose, dark clothing and flip flops. The solution needs room to breathe; so do you.

### The first 8 hours
This is when your shade develops. No water, no sweat, no tight straps. When the time is up, rinse in lukewarm water without soap and pat, never rub, yourself dry. The outcome will be the best tan you dreamed of ❤️

### The days after
Keep showers short and lukewarm, and give pools and long sea swims a few days' grace. Cared for this way, your glow fades slowly, evenly, and entirely on its own terms.

## What makes it different

Everyone's skin has its own natural shade— an undertone of olive, rose, or gold that decides how color will develop on it. After two decades of customising tans daily, I can predict your perfect spraytan shade before applying a single drop of solution. The result is a shade that suits only you and your desired tan. No two spray tans are the same.

My solutions are imported, FDA approved, and blended by hand in my studio. I also carry PETA safe products, free of scents, parabens free, and the option to contour.  My spraytan technique is refined after tanning thousands of brides, editorial shoots, and celebrities— whether you'd like to look like you spent the summer in Ibiza or just don't want to look like you're white as a ghost with just a hint of color, I've got you covered!
